theorems.name: Submission.injective_fderiv_local_lower_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → F) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), DifferentiableAt ℝ f w → Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ f w) → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ‖u‖ ≤ c → c * ‖u‖ ≤ ‖f (w + u) - f w‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
